title: Casa al Mare
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Casa Al Mare”, a luxury 5-bed, 5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 24 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Resort Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 -3 Minute walk to the Beach -Pool House Game Room with Additional Sleeping -Peloton -6 Seater Golf Cart Included -6 Bikes Included Nestled in the serene community of Seagrove, just a stone's throw away from the pristine beach, Casa al Mare is a brand-new construction that redefines luxury living. This exquisite property boasts a private pool making it the perfect oasis for your next vacation. Immerse yourself in a world of elegance as you step inside the main house. Light and airy, it features carefully curated details such as shiplap accent walls, gleaming wood floors, and an abundance of natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows and a modern gas fireplace create a welcoming ambiance in the open-concept living and dining area. The well-appointed kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with stainless steel appliances, including a 6-burner gas range, and custom light fixtures. Doors open seamlessly to the outside living space, where you can enjoy the gentle coastal breeze. The second floor back deck offers breathtaking views of the resort-style pool and spa, with a covered porch and grill for al fresco dining. (Pool heating available for an additional fee). The Main House of Casa al Mare in Old Seagrove" offers luxurious sleeping arrangements for up to 24 guests. The first floor features a King Bedroom with Ensuite Bathroom featuring a Shower with light pouring in the thoughtfully included skylight. The second level boasts the Primary Suite with an Ensuite Bathroom featuring a luxury spa shower and luscious soaker tub. In addition, there are two King Bedrooms each with shower ensuites, and a King Bedroom with Ensuite Bathroom featuring a Shower Only, accompanied by a separate Queen/Queen Bunk for added flexibility. These thoughtfully designed sleeping quarters ensure that you and your guests enjoy comfort and privacy during your stay at this exceptional coastal retreat. In addition to its luxurious accommodations and amenities, Casa al Mare in Old Seagrove" offers added conveniences for your stay. Explore the charming surroundings with ease using the provided 6-seater golf cart. Whether you're headed to the beach or want to cruise around the community, this convenient mode of transportation adds to your enjoyment. You might choose to embrace the coastal lifestyle and explore the area on two wheels. With 6 bikes at your disposal, you can take leisurely rides through Seagrove, discovering its hidden gems and scenic beauty. These complimentary amenities ensure that you have all the tools to make the most of your vacation, from convenient transportation options to the freedom to explore the area at your own pace. Your stay at Casa al Mare promises to be both luxurious and memorable. Indulge in the luxury of Casa al Mare in Old Seagrove, where every detail has been meticulously designed to ensure your vacation is nothing short of extraordinary. Whether you're lounging by the pool, strolling to the nearby beach, or enjoying the charm of Seagrove, this property offers a world of comfort and sophistication. Book your stay today and create unforgettable memories on the Gulf Coast. Sleeping Arrangements First floor King Bedroom w/ Shower Only Second Floor King Bedroom w/ Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Shower & Tub King Bed w/ Shower Only & separate Queen/Queen Bunk Queen Sleeper Sofa Pool House 2 Queen over Queen Bunks w/ Bathroom, Shower Only
